Method of Attack: Deploying ransomware to encrypt targets' networks and extort ransom payments
Using ransomware as a service (RaaS) affiliate model to blend in with other affiliates and evade sanctions
Impersonation of other hacking groups (e.g., PayloadBin) to obscure identity
Code obfuscation and rebranding to evade detection and attribution
Discoverer: U.S. Treasury Department's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)
Impacted Systems: Financial systems impacted by Dridex malware causing over $100 million in damages
Attack Vector: Use of ransomware as a service (RaaS) affiliate infrastructure
